help: makes tab complete corpus-yoga in zsh, by writing its block into ~/.zshrc and clearing zsh's cached completion lists - run by corpus-yoga status satisfy
would: would install - open a new terminal afterwards

does: rewrites the corpus-yoga completion block in ~/.zshrc, outside the repository - four lines, and compinit's two where ~/.zshrc has none
removes zsh's cached completion lists, outside the repository, so the next terminal builds them afresh with the block in place
